messages:
maya: Quick thread  Post-launch handoff: we need a compact, repeatable decision flow for bugs vs enhancements. Want a single-pager with ownership and release slices.

drew: Agree. Proposal: urgent (P0/P1) hotfix lane, scheduled fixes (P2) for the next sprint window, and feature/enhancement lane (P3+) batched into an 8-week maintenance release.

lin: Suggest we tie SLA to revenue band: Tier A customers (>$250k ARR) get guaranteed 24h response + optional expedited hotfix. Others follow standard windows. CS must tag items on intake.

olivia: From eng: define "expedited" clearly. Also propose a "defect tax" cap: reserve 25% team capacity for reactive work during the first 3 quarters post-launch. If exceeded, we trigger a roadmap pause.

sam: Telemetry thresholds: sustained error >0.75% for 10m -> P1; customer complaint + repro -> escalate to P0 if data loss. I'll add panels and a PD rule.

maya: Draft SLA bullets I will put in the one-pager: P0: security/data loss -> immediate oncall + patch within 24h. P1: core flow broken -> triage within 4h, aim patch in 72h. P2: degraded but workaround -> schedule next sprint or hotfix if >1% traffic affected. P3: backlog.

drew: For scheduling: P2s with estimate >8 dev-days become P3 unless customer SLA forces exception. We need a quick-est template: short repro, unit/regression test plan, rollback plan, rough estimate.

olivia: Grouped 8-week release rules: must include feature flags, smoke-tests, canary at 5% traffic for 24h, automatic rollback criteria. I'll write the checklist.

cs-bot: Reminder: tag customer items as Tier A/B/C at intake. Template link: https://redwood.internal/cs/intake-template

deploy-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/postlaunch-handoff (auto-post)

maya: Actions: 1) lin -> customer-SLA tagging workflow + doc snippet by EOD. 2) drew -> quick-est template + capacity note. 3) olivia -> grouped-release checklist + rollback playbook. 4) sam -> dashboards + PD rules. I'll compile one-pager and share Fri.

lin: Confirmed. I'll also add an alert to ping CS owner for Tier A customers automatically.

drew: Confirmed. I'll draft the template and add to issue templates.

olivia: Confirmed. Will include exact kubectl commands and feature-flag kill switch examples.

sam: Confirmed. Will post initial dashboard link in this thread when ready.

maya: Small ask: let's keep the one-pager short. If we need deep details link out to runbooks/docs. Aim to publish to handbook by Monday.

drew: No blockers.

olivia: Nothing blocking.

maya: Thanks all  Closing loop: I'll post the draft one-pager here for review before handbook publish.
